summary.intent: Assess and plan Phase 72 (SDK write-plane durability/correctness), triage stale/newly-added todos for Phases 70-73, then execute plan-72-72's full plan→execute→verify→ship pipeline — interrupted mid-flow by discovering and fixing three CI regressions (web-e2e floor store, FUSE seq-1 equivocation, sdk-e2e Test 21 flake) plus web-e2e flakiness, before resuming and completing Phase 72 execution.
summary.outcome: Retired 8 stale Phase 71 todos and folded 2 new ones into Phase 72/73 scope; diagnosed and shipped fixes for three CI regressions via PR #601 (merged) and #600 (merged); fully planned, executed (10 plans across 7 waves), and verified Phase 72 including a new CI-wide test-typecheck gate, migration of ~113 stale test-file TS errors, resurfacing/fixing a real DoS-class cycle-guard bug in collectDescendantIpnsNames, and passing live sdk-e2e write-plane validation (26/26) — final todo/verification commit made, phase ready to ship.

repo: `.planning/todos/` uses pending→completed as the closure mechanism (not a separate resolved/ folder); a phase can ship without retiring its source todos, causing drift across later phases

ci-e2e.yml (Web/Desktop E2E) triggers ONLY on push-to-main or workflow_dispatch, never on PRs — validate via `gh workflow run <file> --ref <branch>` (the `-f ref=` input form fails with HTTP 422 on older workflow definitions)

Playwright web-e2e `ciFloor()` helper raises wait timeouts to 60s only under CI; local runs use much tighter timeouts (15-30s), causing IPNS-gated mutation tests (batch delete/move, restore, shared mkdir) to reliably flake locally on a real dev machine even though they pass in CI

To get a representative local web-e2e run matching CI's timeout regime, must set CI=1, but that also flips `webServer.reuseExistingServer` to false (fights an already-running local API/vite) — must temporarily patch playwright.config.ts reuse flags for local CI-equivalent verification

vitest ignores .env files — sdk-e2e test harness reads `process.env.SDK_E2E_SECRET` directly with an insecure fallback default, so secrets must be explicitly exported into the shell before running, even when .env matches the API's config
Restarting the local API from `nest start --watch` reads current .env/source, but this alone doesn't fix sdk-e2e secret mismatches if the test process itself never received the exported env var

Root tsconfig.json includes test files but `tsconfig.build.json` excludes them; CI's `pnpm typecheck` only ran package `build` scripts, so test-file TypeScript errors (113 across 15 files) were never caught in CI — a systemic gap now closed by adding per-package `typecheck` scripts run after build

sdk test files had drifted from Phase-62's type retirement (FileMetadata/FolderChild/FolderEntry/FolderMetadata removed, SealedChildRef/Node/writeKey shape changes) — much deeper than a simple vitest v2→v3 Mock-generics migration

`dfsFindFolder` in client.ts threads a `visited: Set<string>` guard against cyclic/malicious folder graphs; sibling `collectDescendantIpnsNames` lacked this guard entirely, an unbounded-recursion DoS-class gap only surfaced when re-enabling a previously stub-skipped test

Share DTO fields were renamed in Phase 71 (#599): readDescriptorRef→encryptedReadKey, writeDescriptorRef→encryptedWriteKey, rootIpnsName→shareRootIpnsName — stale desktop-e2e `.mts` driver scripts using old field names fail with 400 via `forbidNonWhitelisted` ValidationPipe

IPNS anti-equivocation gate (Phase 71) rejects same-sequence republish with a different CID; FUSE per-file first-publish hardcoded seq=1 on every call, colliding with this gate on rotation re-key — fix is to resolve-before-first-publish and fall through to CAS bump on `Found`

Phase 70.1 collapsed two IndexedDB stores (generation-high-water, seq-high-water) into one `rotation-floor` store (DB `cipherbox-rotation-state` v2, keyed by nodeId) — stale test helpers pointing at old store names silently return undefined instead of erroring

code.finding: publish_file_node hardcoded seq=1 on first-publish branch; fixed to resolve IPNS first and route Found outcome through publish_with_cas_retry with resolved_seq to avoid double-resolve and equivocation

publish_with_cas_retry gained optional preresolved_seq param (perf follow-up from greptile review) to skip a redundant second resolve on the Found/stale-hint re-publish path; conflict-retry path still always re-resolves
readDurableFloors/writeDurableSeqFloor updated to read/write the single rotation-floor IndexedDB store instead of retired generation-high-water/seq-high-water stores

collectDescendantIpnsNames lacked cycle-guard present in sibling dfsFindFolder; added threaded visited:Set<string> across all three call sites to prevent unbounded recursion on cyclic/malicious folder graphs

workflow: When a background verification agent's diagnosis surfaces a real product bug (not just a test issue), size and fix it inline before declaring the phase done rather than deferring — this session found and closed a DoS-class gap this way

For local reproduction of CI-only flakes, matching CI's exact env/timeout config (not just approximating it) is necessary — repeated 'representative' local runs under local defaults wasted multiple 5-10min cycles before switching to true CI=1 emulation
Sequencing a systemic hardening task (typecheck-all-tests-in-ci) as the LAST plan in a phase lets it cover every new test file the phase creates in one pass instead of fixing drift wave-by-wave

GSD workflow gates (plan-checker, phase verifier) tolerate cosmetic/doc-sync warnings without blocking — worth distinguishing blocking vs non-blocking findings rather than chasing all warnings to zero
Dispatching workflow_dispatch e2e runs against a feature branch before merging avoids merging blind when the CI e2e suite doesn't run on PRs
Capturing a discovered gap as a durable todo file immediately (even mid-execution) prevents losing tracking of deferred work across a long autonomous run

friction: Wasted ~5 local-run cycles (each ~5-15 min) chasing a moving target of flaky tests (4.10→4.11→2.1) before realizing local timeout regimes are systematically tighter than CI's ciFloor-adjusted ones, requiring a CI=1 emulation workaround
gh workflow_dispatch with `-f ref=` returned HTTP 422 because main's workflow definition predated that input; had to fall back to `--ref <branch>`
git commit hung ~2min on a 1Password SSH-signing prompt during a background agent run (known recurring issue per project memory), requiring manual verification that the commit actually landed
Raw JSON hook fragments (multiline strings not strict JSON) broke the naive parser; required writing a custom lenient parser script to extract plan:pre hook fragments

sdk-e2e test-login repeatedly failed with 401 due to stale API dist/process not reflecting current .env, and separately due to vitest not loading .env at all — two distinct causes of the same symptom, requiring separate diagnosis passes

Phase 71 shipped (#599) with three separate pieces of undetected test/fixture drift (D-16 .mts driver stale DTO fields, sdk-e2e Test 21 assertion not accounting for its own idempotency design, and exposing a latent FUSE seq-1 bug) — a ship-quality gap worth a retrospective note
